questions.question: Is resistance exercise alone sufficient to prevent falls in older adults, without balance training?
questions.gold_passage: “Physical therapists should NOT provide or prescribe resistance training ALONE to older adults if the purpose is to reduce the risk and/or rate of falls.” / “multicomponent exercise… must include balance training.”
questions.gold_answer: No. The guideline advises against resistance training alone for fall prevention. A multicomponent exercise program must include balance training.

questions.question: Is it safe to continue mechanically loaded foot exercises in a patient with diabetes who has a pre-ulcerative lesion or active foot ulcer?
questions.gold_passage: “People with a pre-ulcerative lesion or with a foot ulcer should not partake in foot-related exercises in which the foot is mechanically loaded, as there is still no evidence if these exercises are safe.”
